name: canvas-connector-personal
description: Run the open-source Canvas connector locally for your own account.
long_description: Personal, single-user local use with your own Canvas token. This extension is not the hosted multi-user onboarding flow. Schools may restrict API access. Public hosted connections require institution-authorized Canvas OAuth. Writes are disabled by default and still require your exact authorization when enabled. Python and dependencies are managed through the host's UV runtime; first use requires internet access.

canvas_url.title: Your Canvas website
canvas_url.description: Your school's HTTPS Canvas origin, without a course path. Example: https://school.instructure.com

canvas_token.title: Your personal Canvas token
canvas_token.description: For your own single-user local connection only. Stored through the host's secure credential storage. Do not share someone else's token or use this for public hosted onboarding.

allow_writes.title: Enable prepared Canvas actions
allow_writes.description: Allow specifically authorized submissions, comments, discussions, messages, uploads, personal file organization, notifications, preferences, module progress, calendar, planner, course invitation, bookmark, hypothetical grade, Mastery Path, group membership and feedback marker changes. Host approvals and your exact instructions still apply.
